entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. I... I think I need to return something? I'm a bit lost with how this all works. It's a helmet.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, I think so... it's VF886-21. I just... I don't understand the rules on your website. It's all very overwhelming.

No problem at all, let's take a look. I see the order for the AeroStream helmet, delivered 37 days ago. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's just the color. My wife said it clashes horribly with my bike. I never even took it out, the box is still unopened. I just got so confused looking at the policy. Can't you just help me?
Of course. I understand completely. Getting the right gear is important, especially for your safety. Let me just review the return policy for you.
Okay, I've checked our system. According to our policy, you have 90 days from the delivery date to return an item. Since you're at 37 days, you are well within that window for a full refund.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! I was so worried I had missed the deadline. Thank you so much.

You're very welcome. I'm happy I could clear that up. I'm processing the return authorization now and will email you a pre-paid shipping label. You just need to print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any UPS location.
That's wonderful. Thank you, Isaac. You've been a great help.
My pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Thank you again.
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
